market_rate.source: Update with the State Bank of Pakistan interbank rate or Google's USD to PKR rate on the day you check.

tax.note: Final tax on IT/ITES export proceeds received through banking channels (Budget 2026-27). Verify on FBR/PSEB before launch.

upwork.label: Upwork
upwork.note: Upwork charges a variable 0-15% fee per contract, shown before you submit a proposal.

fiverr.label: Fiverr
fiverr.note: Fiverr keeps 20% of each order for sellers.

direct.label: Direct client
direct.note: No platform fee when a client pays you directly.

routes.label: Upwork → direct to local bank
routes.note: Flat $0.99 per withdrawal, but Upwork's banking partner converts at a weaker rate than the market.

routes.label: Upwork → Payoneer → bank
routes.note: Payoneer converts USD to PKR at about 2% below the market rate when you withdraw to a Pakistani bank.

routes.label: Fiverr → Payoneer → bank
routes.note: Fiverr's Payoneer transfer fee plus Payoneer's conversion markup.

routes.label: Fiverr → direct to local bank
routes.note: Fiverr's local bank transfer option for Pakistan.

routes.label: Payoneer → JazzCash
routes.note: JazzCash converts close to the market rate, but Payoneer charges about 2% to send to the wallet (plus 1% to receive from a direct client, or Fiverr's $1 transfer fee).

routes.label: Client pays Payoneer → bank
routes.note: Payoneer's 1% fee when a client pays by bank transfer, plus the conversion markup.

routes.label: Client pays Wise → bank
routes.note: Wise uses the market rate with a small fee. Check whether Wise can receive payments for your Pakistani account.
